entities.name: Kenshi Sakashima
entities.description: Human rogue of Kamigawa, an orphan and master of disguise who eventually deceived the kami.

entities.name: Chinsen
entities.description: Master illusionist who taught Kenshi illusionary arts.

entities.name: Soratami
entities.description: Flying-city people Kenshi infiltrated and posed as leader of.

entities.name: Realm of the Kami
entities.description: Impossible target Kenshi desired to infiltrate.

events.summary: Kenshi learns illusionary arts from the master illusionist Chinsen.
events.quote: moving on to learn illusionary arts from master illusionist Chinsen

events.summary: Kenshi infiltrates ogre strongholds, kitsune forests, orochi colonies and the soratami cities, posing as the soratami leader.
events.quote: he mustered the nerve and skill to pose as their leader and rule them

events.summary: Kenshi eventually achieves his dream of deceiving the kami.
events.quote: He hoped to someday deceive even the kami

relations.quote: learn illusionary arts from master illusionist Chinsen
